acceptance fixture).

## Decisions in scope

- `DR-SYN-001` — drives the decoration shape.
- `AN-001` and `AN-002` — table-row codes the decorator must hyperlink

- `BG-001` — build-gate placeholder.
- `OD-001` — open-decision placeholder.
